name: Post Vault
description: Focused Telegram post saver and live channel clone

DB_NAME.description: Database name for saved settings and clone state

MASTER_KEY.description: Unique key for encrypting saved Telegram sessions and bot tokens

IV_KEY.description: Unique IV/key material for encrypted credentials

OWNER_ID.description: Optional numeric user IDs allowed to refresh the /start command list with /set

FORCE_SUB.description: Optional required channel ID; use 0 to disable

LOG_GROUP.description: Optional log group for the large-file delivery path

STRING.description: Optional user session for the large-file delivery path
